name: infocutter
description: Manifest V3 DOM-hiding Chrome extension for managing per-site selectors.

scripts.pipe:build: npm run pipe:clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/build.mjs
scripts.pipe:rebuild: npm run pipe:clean-all && npm run pipe:build && npm run pipe:doctor
scripts.pipe:check: npm run pipe:lint && npm run pipe:typecheck && npm run pipe:test
scripts.pipe:rc: npm run pipe:rebuild && npm run pipe:check && npm run pipe:package
